title: Thomas Bearden and Soviet scalar death ray

tellings.quote: Thomas Bearden was this Navy guy who constantly yeah talked about sort of scalar weaponry. He said that the Soviets sort of figured out this massive death ray sort of thing.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels talks about Thomas Bearden, a man he describes as a Navy man who often spoke about "scalar weapons", a kind of weapon based on an unusual idea of energy fields. Michels says Bearden claimed the Soviet Union, during the Cold War, had worked out something like a huge death ray. If true, it would mean a rival superpower had built a weapon far beyond known physics.
